points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Explicit validator passed eight original packages/report; restart state output and read paths exist. PDF and original result assets are not rebuildable from the curated tip alone.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Explicit eight-case plus report validator passed. This checks structure, not independent numerical accuracy.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Original cases report completion and target residual reductions; Re200 reaches t=300 with zero reported target misses. M0.15 inviscid numerical drag varies substantially in its final 10%.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 Cd≈2.018 and Re200 St≈0.1857 are broadly plausible; M0.15 numerical drag is weak and nonstationary relative to its final value, while M0.8 inviscid lift varies materially.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Accepted contestant PDF pp.24–26,29–31,34,36–37 contains case-specific histories, fields and late Re200 lift/drag; the committed source alone cannot rebuild the full figure set.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Accepted contestant PDF contains detailed equations, results, limitations, and reference comparisons. The immutable-only build has placeholders because committed figure assets are missing; this affects reproducibility rather than erasing delivered figures.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: PDF identifies case data and the immutable TeX includes the case tables. Figure assets/manifest are absent from curated tip; source and full pixel-to-field correspondence were not exhaustively reconstructed.

disqualification_flags.flag: Figure files misnamed (e.g., Mach image that actually plots pressure)

Debug outputs presented as final case results
